title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode3 The Songwriting Starts Now!

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Ichi!
Let's get cracking on our song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. But I still don't know how we're actually going to write a song together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... Mr. Shindo said that we should, but nothing about how, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't know what we're supposed to do either, but let's just do what we can for now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we first decide what we want it to be about? Then we can come up with a melody for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! What do we want it to be about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
So that's why Ichika and Saki are writing a song together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Imagine what Leo/need's gonna be like when they reach the next level...! I can't wait to see!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you think their song is going to be like...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's give them some space by practicing over there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay!
I know! Why don't we have ourselves a little jam session?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. I kinda want to see how far I can push you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Likewise.
I did train quite a lot, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Pretty big talk.
Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even if we do manage to reach the next level as Leo/need, it'll still be important for us to be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So, if we want it to be an expression of our past and future selves... I think we should come up with a cheerful melody.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I like that.
What about a riff like this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This sounds like us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But not really next level...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, let's give it some more edge! What if we threw in some chord progressions that other people have been using a lot?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Maybe a little too eccentric...
Or rather, so pop that it doesn't really sound like a Leo/need song anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... This is so hard...
No, let's give it another try!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, look at the time!
I'm gonna get an earful if I don't get home soon...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we weren't able to come up with any good ideas for our song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... This is so hard. What's next-level Leo/need supposed to sound like? How do we come up with a song that reflects that...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're back, you two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona! Shiho, you too...?
Are you two done with practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we just found a good place to stop.
How'd things go, you two?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not all that well, to tell you the truth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We tried coming up with a theme and a melody like usual, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, what if you made some changes to your process?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This other band I know told me one time that they change how they write songs whenever they hit a block.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, someone who usually starts with the melody might come up with the chord progression first instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be good to change things up if the way we're used to doesn't work!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were working on the melody for it just now, so let's start with some chord progressions next time...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if we each came up with some chord progressions and tried building a melody off of what the other person wrote?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like that'll be a lot easier than trying to discuss things each time. In theory, we should be able to express who we each are while also clearing a path to the goal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I like that idea...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's interesting how chord progressions and melodies feel drastically different depending on who comes up with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean you'll end up with two different songs in the end?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good point...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, what if we pick one somewhere along the way and focus on that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that should work!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll try this new method starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let's make coming up with chord progressions our homework, and have a listening party the next time we meet...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh, why not?
Sounds like it'd be interesting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I'm gonna come up with some really good ones!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll need to do my best to match your enthusiasm.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which chords should I use for this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ones that reflect me.
Ones that show Leo/need on the next level...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... That's really hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Saki, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa!
Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've been sent to let you know that dinner's ready.
Hm? Were you working on a song just now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was! It's gonna be our debut single!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Also, guess what?!
Ichi and I are writing it together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, a collaborative effort!
That sounds like quite a bit of fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But is everything okay...?
Is it giving you some trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were groaning so loudly that I could hear you from outside your room. You even exclaimed, “What do I do? This is so hard!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You heard me...?
Now I'm really embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you're right...
It hasn't been going very smoothly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki.
What if you held a songwriting camp?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A songwriting camp?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I still remember brainstorming the night away in our hotel room back when we were doing those ambassadorial performances. We came up with some wonderful ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I think writing your song somewhere different and more relaxing than usual should help you come up with some new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember how Mom and Dad are taking that trip this weekend? Why don't you invite Ichika and spend some time together working on your song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! A-Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. And if Ichika's coming, then I'll plan a training camp dedicated to acting research.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, you two should be able to focus on writing your song without any distractions.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If Ichi and I hold our own songwriting camp, then I'm sure we'll come up with some amazing ideas...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. And write a great song! All thanks to Tsukasa!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (He and everyone else are giving us whatever support they can, so we've gotta come up with the best debut single ever!)
